body.name: positive-law ordered-weight estimator
body.construction: Write the positive law estimator uniquely as \(\widehat\nu_n=\sum_{\ell=1}^{\widehat s_n}\widehat w_{\ell,n}\delta_{\widehat\tau_{\ell,n}}\), where \(\widehat\tau_{1,n}<\cdots<\widehat\tau_{\widehat s_n,n}\) and every \(\widehat w_{\ell,n}>0\). If \(\widehat s_n=k\), set \(\widehat p_n^{\uparrow}:=(\widehat w_{1,n},\ldots,\widehat w_{k,n})\); if \(\widehat s_n<k\), set \(\widehat p_n^{\uparrow}:=(1/k,\ldots,1/k)\). Ordering the finitely many support points and extracting their jump sizes are Borel operations, so this defines a total Borel map into \(\Delta^{k-1}\) without an undeclared dependence on \(\alpha\).
